label: Page Hero
title: Page Hero
summary: Use a Page Hero at the top of a feature or offer page: media, a short eyebrow, the offer as a headline, its price, and one action.
corePrinciple: One offer, said once, with one next step.

configuration.title: Media, size, actions, and the page
configuration.description: media takes any Coin element, such as an Image or an Icon Capsule, in a box Video / Output sizes to 117, 70, or 20 px; give it something that size, because the box clips the rest. PageHero Size S makes the text smaller, with an 18 px headline and 12 px gaps; set Button / Size S with it, as Figma does. The hero passes its modes to the button, so AppearanceBrand recolours it, and buttonSlot replaces it, for example with two stacked buttons. Page type JioPlus turns the text white for the JioFinance+ page’s dark backdrop.

states.title: Full, or shorter
states.description: The hero doesn’t press or load; its button is its only action. showEyebrow, showSupportingText, showBody, and showButton hide their parts, and an empty headline hides the headline. body shows only once you pass one. Pass media only when you have some: media={false} still leaves an empty box.

sizing.title: Full width, 16 px inside
sizing.description: The hero fills its host’s width and keeps 16 px clear on each side, but adds nothing above or below, so the screen gives it room. Its parts are 16 px apart and the eyebrow sits 8 px above the headline. With the default copy in a 328 px host it is 328 × 225, and the headline wraps to three 35 px lines. Figma’s hero has no side padding, and its eyebrow and headline lines are 20 and 29 px.
specimen: Resume earning cashback, extra points, and 1% gold

content.title: The offer, its price, a verb
content.description: Write eyebrow as a short category, such as Upgrade to JioFinance+, and headline as the offer in one sentence. Put the price or term in supportingText and a second, different fact in body. Make buttonLabel a short verb: it stays on one line and is cut off if it’s too long.

sources.title: Use the public Page Hero contract
sources.description: The guide compares the Figma component with the installed package and its Storybook stories.
blocks: Installed jfs-components is 0.1.78 (23 October build of Biscuit’s main) from the team’s private package repository. Figma’s Page Hero has Eybrow, Headline, Supporting text, and Body text properties and switches for each part, media, and the buttons; it shows media, the body, and two stacked buttons by default, where the package shows one button until you pass media, a body, or a buttonSlot. The package adds 16 px of side padding, its eyebrow and headline lines are taller than Figma’s, PageHero Size S leaves the button at M, and Storybook’s Default story shows the price twice (all reported).
